rules: No recursive bulk copy is authorized by this manifest.
Cache and secret-bearing entries are not copy eligible.
A proposed destination is a migration routing decision, not proof that the file has moved.
Runtime source is routed through deterministic staging because M3 and M4 own the final RWO/runtime split.
Historical evidence retains original digests and is never rewritten in place.
claim_ceiling: M0 source identity and classification only; no move, merge, deletion, runtime effect, release, deployment, publication, or authority effect.
